newsitem.title: UK: London platinum fixes at lowest since Dec 3, 1993.
newsitem.headline: London platinum fixes at lowest since Dec 3, 1993.

text.p: Platinum was fixed at $373.75 per ounce on Monday, its lowest fixing since December 3, 1993.
On Friday morning, it fixed at $374.50, its lowest setting since December 6 1993.
London platinum fixes at lowest since Dec 3, 1993
The market has been losing ground behind a withering gold market for several weeks.
One dealer noted that at this time of year demand for platinum traditionally reaches it peak.
"That simply hasn't happened this year, the funds are selling it and there are plenty of inventories around. Metal just cannmot be absorbed," the dealer said.
